title: Incomprehensibility of God
definition: The incomprehensibility of God means that God can be known truly because He reveals Himself, but He cannot be known exhaustively by finite creatures.
summary: God is truly knowable, but never fully comprehended by human minds.
christFocus: Jesus makes the Father truly known, while the fullness of God's glory remains beyond creaturely measure.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
God is not unknowable, because He has revealed Himself in creation, Scripture, and Christ. Believers can know Him truly, personally, and savingly.

Yet God cannot be known exhaustively. He is infinite, and humans are finite. His wisdom, glory, power, and being exceed full creaturely understanding.

This doctrine invites both confidence and humility: confidence because God has spoken, humility because He remains greater than human understanding.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: People often want to master God as a subject or reject what they cannot fully explain. The incomprehensibility of God matters because it teaches humble worship and trusting faith.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Receive what God has revealed and be humble about what He has not. Let mystery lead to worship rather than speculation or unbelief.
